title: Cache Invalidation
description: Learn how to keep cached data fresh: TTL, eviction policies, stampede prevention, manual invalidation, and cache warming.
longDescription: The hardest problem in caching is invalidation: knowing when cached data is stale and safely refreshing it. This module covers TTLs, eviction, stampede prevention, and warming strategies.
whatYouLearn: Set appropriate TTLs and expiration strategies
Warm a cache before high-traffic events
